note: structure r1 회수 기록 — 두 시도 모두 readback-incomplete(리뷰어 code 필드 따옴표 미이스케이프)로 게이트 아티팩트는 ok:false였고, 답은 판독 원문에서 무손실 회수됐다(HRG 토큰·카운트 검증 + 인용 트리 대조 전건 일치). 트리아지 결정은 decisions.md의 structure r1 절 2개가 SSOT다.

a.summary: No-ship: 결과 계약과 transport 경계가 후속 동사와 MCP를 받치지 못한다.

findings.title: 결과 스키마가 verb별 계약을 판별하지 못한다
findings.body: 'result'가 열린 object라 doctor 정의도 root에 연결되지 않는다. 후속 shape가 갈라진다.
findings.recommendation: verb별 result를 지금 정의하고 oneOf로 verb·variant·exitCode를 묶어라.

findings.title: VERBS가 transport-neutral operation을 표현하지 못한다
findings.body: VERBS는 argv→exit code만 보존한다. MCP 결과와 노출 정책은 별도 registry로 복제된다.
findings.recommendation: typed operation result를 반환하고 CLI·MCP가 한 renderer를 쓰게 하라.

findings.title: doctor의 template preflight가 실제 init 계약을 증명하지 않는다
findings.body: 두 문자열만 찾으므로 '--name' 계약이 깨져도 pass한다. init은 repo 생성 뒤 실패할 수 있다.
findings.recommendation: versioned contract를 만들고 doctor와 init이 같은 검사 함수를 쓰게 하라.

next_steps: schema와 operation-result seam을 후속 동사 전에 고정한다.
doctor와 init이 공유할 versioned template contract를 만든다.
수정 뒤 structure gate를 다시 실행한다.

b.summary: Do not extend this skeleton until its result and command seams are repaired.

findings.title: The root schema ignores every verb-specific result contract
findings.body: Any result validates; doctorResult is dead. Malformed CLI/MCP output stays green.
findings.recommendation: Use a verb-discriminated union; validate only complete envelopes.

findings.title: The schema does not enforce variant-to-exit-code mapping
findings.body: Variant and exitCode are independent; even success with exit 1 validates.
findings.recommendation: Encode allowed pairs as branches and add mismatch-rejection tests.

findings.title: The verb registry is a CLI-only seam that MCP cannot reuse
findings.body: VERBS stores CLI handlers; MCP must duplicate routing and teardown policy.
findings.code: const VERBS: Array<{ path: string[]; desc: string; run: (rest: string[]) => number }> = [
findings.recommendation: Use descriptors with typed input, MCP exposure, and result executors.

next_steps: Repair the schema and add negative full-envelope tests before implementing more verbs.
Refactor the registry before mutation and status handlers copy the CLI-only pattern.

attempts.triage: a1·b1·b2·a2·b3 Accept(수리 커밋 27db0ae), a3 Defer(티켓 11 노트)

a.summary: Do not build further slices on this skeleton; both public seams need redesign.

findings.title: The command catalog is not a reusable source of truth
findings.body: VERBS is private and argv-shaped; MCP must bypass it or copy CLI logic.
findings.code: const VERBS: Array<{ path: string[]; desc: string; run: (rest: string[]) => VerbOutput }> = [
findings.recommendation: Move typed operations to an import-safe catalog used by CLI and MCP; add schema parity.

findings.title: Result shapes are not discriminated by outcome
findings.body: Doctor validates pending, race, and no-op with one result shape; agents cannot branch safely.
findings.recommendation: Model valid verb/variant pairs and require variant-specific evidence in each result.

next_steps: Extract the command kernel before adding the next verb.
Replace the all-variants doctor test with an allowed-outcome matrix per verb.

b.summary: Do not ship: operations and result states are not yet sound extension seams.

findings.title: The operation seam is still CLI-specific
findings.body: CLI concerns leak into the result; MCP must wrap or duplicate each verb.
findings.code: | { kind: "result"; json: boolean; envelope: Envelope; human: string[] };
findings.recommendation: Put typed operations in lib; keep argv parsing and rendering in the CLI.

findings.title: The schema does not discriminate state-specific results
findings.body: Only verb selects result shape; invalid variant/result pairs remain valid.
findings.recommendation: Use one union over verb, variant, result shape, and exit code.

next_steps: Extract a side-effect-free operation registry before adding mutation verbs.
Replace independent schema couplings with verb/variant/result branches.
